nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Rust crate manifest for the floppy Tauri backend, declaring the cdylib/rlib/staticlib library, core crypto and transport dependencies (iroh, iroh-blobs, rustls/ring, ed25519/x25519, spake2, chacha20poly1305), Tauri plugins, and platform-gated mobile dependencies for Android and iOS.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses cfg-gated [target.'cfg(...)'.dependencies] tables to include mobile-only crates (tauri-plugin-android-fs pinned with '=', tauri-plugin-ios-webview-insets) without adding weight to desktop builds.

nodes.name: tauri.conf.json
nodes.summary: Tauri 2 application configuration defining the app identifier, dev/build commands and frontend dist path, the main window geometry and overlay title bar, the 'floppy' deep-link scheme for desktop and mobile, and bundle targets and icons.

nodes.name: Info.ios.plist
nodes.summary: iOS property list merged into the generated Info.plist at build, exposing the app's Documents directory in the Files app (UIFileSharingEnabled, LSSupportsOpeningDocumentsInPlace) and declaring local-network and photo-library usage descriptions required for iroh LAN hole-punching and the photo picker.
nodes.languageNotes: Kept as a separate merge file so the entries survive an 'ios init' regeneration of the generated plist.
